title: Clinical Trial Failures: stopped clinical trials classified by why they stopped
description:
Terminated, suspended and withdrawn trials from ClinicalTrials.gov, classified by the sponsor's stated stop reason into biological failure signals (efficacy, futility, safety) and non-biological causes (recruitment, funding, strategy, regulatory), with the evidence span each label rests on. Completed Phase 2/3 trials are read for a missed primary endpoint. Rebuilt weekly; browse it at clinicaltrialfailures.com.
